standard: # PREPARED BY CLAUDE (Cowork) 2026-09-20 FROM THE EXTRACTED PAGE TEXT - NOT BY AN ENGINEER.
# Covers clauses 5.1 to 5.4 only (pages 8-10 of 14). Sections 1-4 and 5.5 onward are NOT marked up.
# Recall must therefore be scored against this clause range only. Treat as provisional until an engineer reviews it.

notes: consider purchasing low noise equipment - advisory
project should consider alternative suppliers or engineering controls
engineering controls shall reduce exposure to LESS THAN 90 - strict not <=
areas ABOVE 85 become Noise Hazard Areas - not a ceiling
boundaries and entrances shall be posted with warning signs
ESSS and EIA shall be considered per SAEP-13
noise criterion curves in Table 1 and octave band levels in Table 2
Proponent shall contact EP/IHU for baseline measurements
likely to exceed 85 triggers a Key Drawing contour diagram
potential to exceed 90 after controls triggers a SAEP-302 waiver
closed spaces above 85 trigger echo/reverberation design
above 85 at one metre triggers Form 7305-ENG - NOT a limit
EP/IHU may visit the manufacturer - permissive
THE PRIMARY LIMIT - new equipment at one metre after feasible controls
exception 1 - emergency sirens alarms and loudspeakers
exception 2 - flaring during a single major unit or plant upset
exception 3 - surge valves for peak shaving at maximum flow
exception 4 - pressure relief valves
exceeding the limit requires Form 7305-ENG and a SAEP-302 waiver
continuous exposure limits are in Table 3
dosimeters shall be used - instrument range 80 to 130 dB is not a limit
A-weighted slow response 5 dB exchange rate
instrumentation per ANSI S1.4 and S1.25 calibrated before and after use
peak SPL for impulse/impact noise under one second duration
levels from 80 to 140 dB shall be integrated into measurements
8-hour TWA Action Level triggers Hearing Conservation Program SAEP-371
exposures shall be computed per Table 3
approved hearing protection shall be provided and enforced
EP/IHU monitoring conducted periodically and on request
hierarchy of noise controls - elimination substitution engineering admin PPE
